comment: B’s moderate-rate GRU was the strongest fit for the bigram task. D’s shallow, wider transformer ranked ahead of the deeper, narrower E/C pair; E’s beta2=.95 recipe edged C’s beta2=.999 recipe. A’s RMSprop rate produced nominal displacement 1.536, versus B’s .1536, making excessive fitting a relevant risk rather than a progress advantage. K1071 supported this caution, K1124 supplied nearby GRU-versus-transformer shape evidence, and K1005 kept minor optimizer differences as weak tie-breakers. None alone establishes the complete order: K1124 does not directly cover these optimizer/batch combinations, and nominal displacement is only a proxy. No new tested general rule emerged.
